description: Land Title Settlement Department - Danawalagama, Neluwa D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810653 (23/0129)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations regarding title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their particulars, extents, and ownership details (all listed as "The State"), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category for land and property-related matters.
